title: nRF54L15-DK on-board SPI flash (MX25R6435F on SPIM00) via the Contiki-NG SPI HAL

test.description: examples/platform-specific/nrf/spi-flash (Contiki-NG feature/nrf-spi-driver) reads the JEDEC ID and SFDP header of the DK's MX25R6435F through arch/cpu/nrf/dev/spi-arch.c (blocking nrfx_spim, EasyDMA, 64-byte staging). The expected lines are the real PCA10156's serial output from 2026-09-06: JEDEC c2 28 17, SFDP 53 46 44 50, a 256-byte staged read, and seven consecutive SPIM re-inits at 1..32 MHz all reading the ID back. The report repeats every 5 s; two rounds are required. NB: the bit-rate line is matched as the firmware at contiki-ng 55e7ef6c8 prints it ("bit rates:"); the hardware log captured on 2026-09-06 shows a longer label ("bit rates (requested, driver rounds down):"), so that run used a slightly different build of the example. Every value on every line is identical.

steps.wait: long SFDP: 53 46 44 50 ... ff ff  OK (256 B staged)
